name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Deploy to Modal
      run: bash distributed/deploy/modal-deploy.sh

  deploy-railway:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Deploy to Railway
      run: |
        railway init
        railway up

  deploy-fly-io:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Deploy to Fly.io
      run: bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh

  deploy-render:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Deploy to Render
      run: echo "Deploy to Render button"

  deploy-daytona:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Deploy to Daytona
      run: daytona create
